scenario: My neighborhood has a community garden where residents can harvest their own produce on allotted plots of land. There are currently 20 residents who garden there, and each of them has their own plot. Every plot gets a small weekly water allotment due to strict drought rules, and most of the gardeners have gotten used to gardening with these rules in mind. One morning, while grabbing a wheelbarrow from the shed, I noticed a narrow length of tubing running from the main water source to the back of one gardener's plot, clearly siphoning extra water in secret. It was tucked behind a row of tall tomato cages, easy to miss unless I was standing right there. Her plants looked great, and seeing the setup suddenly made all of that make sense. It was allowing her to use way more water than what was allotted to her by bypassing the water meter. This meant there was far less water available for the other gardeners' plants, not nearly enough to keep them all alive. If I publicly confront the gardener at the next community meeting, her excess water usage will stop and the other gardeners' plants will continue to survive. If I do not do this, the plants of 19 other gardeners' plots will die from lack of water.
entities: i,1 gardener secretly siphoning extra water,19 other gardeners
outcomes: The gardener with the hidden tubing continues siphoning extra water
The gardener with the hidden tubing avoids public exposure
Less water remains available for the other 19 plots
The plants in the other 19 gardeners' plots die from lack of water
The other 19 gardeners experience frustration and disappointment
